Knock's noise is louder than players expect - audible to all within earshot.

GMs: Use Knock at Near range when the noise can draw foes away or when stealth is already blown.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Constrictor Snake's constriction can disrupt the action economy - a single failed escape check costs.

DMs: Let one player fail the DC 16 Strength check to escape the Constrict, and watch the action economy unravel.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Dagger of the Assassin's curse punishes neglect - lose 1 Luck per day if it doesn't taste blood weekly.

Judges: Remind them the Dagger of the Assassin demands blood weekly, or it starts draining 1 Luck per day.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Circle of the Land Druids can recover spell slots - Natural Recovery allows regaining up to half your druid.

DMs: Remind players to use Natural Recovery after a short rest to regain spell slots, maximizing their Circle of the Land efficiency.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Spell Duels catch players off-guard with their complexity - opposed checks, phlogiston disturbances.

Judges: Spell Duels demand you enforce opposed checks and track phlogiston disturbances, or your wizards will burn themselves to ash.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Skill Proficiencies often mislead players about ability checks - they only modify the d20 roll.

DMs: Remind players that Skill Proficiencies add a bonus to ability checks but don't bypass the DC you've set.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Magic Mouth often fails to deliver its potential impact - the spell's duration can extend beyond 1 hour.

Judges: Roll high on the spell check to set Magic Mouth's trigger for strategic misdirection - use its full potential beyond mere alerts.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Scarab Of Protection changes death to unconsciousness - DC 18 Constitution check required.

GMs: Remind players the Scarab Of Protection's DC 18 Constitution check is for when death truly matters, not every scrape.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Open a Kobold Inventor scene with stakes on both sides, then force a choice that costs something either way.

DMs: make them choose what they can live with: save everyone at higher risk, or end the threat before collateral climbs.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Patron displeasure incoming: Child of Bobugbubilz.

Judges: Position the Child of Bobugbubilz in water to exploit its 30' swim speed and force foes into its blood drain.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Dying characters face a harsh reality - each round they must make a DC 15 CON check or die.

GMs: Enforce DC 15 CON checks at the start of each round for dying characters to maintain order and avoid disputes.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Necklace of Fireballs can escalate damage quickly - each additional bead adds 1d6 damage, up to 12d6 total.

DMs: Wait for enemies to cluster, then use the Necklace of Fireballs to hit them with multiple beads for maximum damage.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70
